content.title: Daredevil: Born Again season 2 release time (by time zone), preview, and what to expect
content.text: After nearly a year-long wait, Daredevil: Born Again season 2 is finally upon us. The first season of the show was a big success story for Disney Plus last year, successfully reviving the world of the beloved Netflix series. And that first season also ended with Wilson Fisk being more evil than ever before. How is that possible? Easy, by kidnapping people, creating a corrupt police unit called the Anti-Vigilante, and being an absolute tyrannical ruler of New York. As you can see, Fisk is more crooked now than when he was the Kingpin of crime.Because of Wilson Fisk’s corruption, Daredevil seems to be taking a more proactive approach to protecting his city, and with more help than he’s ever had. However, Matt Murdock admits that, ever since Foggy died, he’s allowed a darkness inside of him. Could this lead to Daredevil becoming like he was in Marvel Comics' Shadowland? We'll have to wait and see. Here’s how you can watch the season premiere to find out. After everything that had previously happened, it’s a wonderful thing that fans didn’t have to wait long for season 2 of Daredevil: Born Again.Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 1 release date and time on Disney+ PlusDaredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 1, titled "The Northern Star", will premiere on Disney Plus in the US on Tuesday, March 24, at 9:00 p.m. ET, 6:00 p.m. PT, 8:00 p.m. CT, and 7:00 p.m. MT. Thankfully, the show will also be released simultaneously around the world in areas with the streaming service, so everyone gets a chance to see it at the same time. With that in mind, here are the global release times for Daredevil: Born Again season 2, including areas such as the UK, Australia, India, and more:Hawaii: 3:00 p.m. HST on Tuesday, March 24Alaska: 5:00 p.m. AKDT on Tuesday, March 24West Coast of the US: 6:00 p.m. PT on Tuesday, March 24Mountain Time: 7:00 p.m. MT on Tuesday, March 24Midwest of the US: 8:00 p.m. CT on Tuesday, March 24East Coast of the US: 9:00 p.m. ET on Tuesday, March 24Brazil: 10:00 p.m. BRT on Tuesday, March 24UK: 1:00 a.m. GMT on Wednesday, March 25France: 2:00 a.m. CET on Wednesday, March 25Germany: 2:00 a.m. CET on Wednesday, March 25India (Disney+ Hotstar): 6:30 a.m. IST on Wednesday, March 25Italy: 2:00 a.m. CET on Wednesday, March 25Spain: 2:00 a.m. CET on Wednesday, March 25South Korea: 10:00 a.m. KST on Wednesday, March 25Japan: 10:00 a.m. JST on Wednesday, March 25Sydney, Australia: 12:00 p.m. AEDT on Wednesday, March 25What to expect in Daredevil: Born Again season 2 episode 1Viewers will see a darker side of both Daredevil and Matt Murdock in Daredevil: Born Again season 2. Marvel Comics fans know that the Man Without Fear has often succumbed to anger when things have gotten bleak. It isn’t something he’s proud of, but it’s a part of him that he can’t overcome. And, from the previews for the upcoming season, people who only know Matt from the show will understand that even the Netflix Daredevil was light compared to what he’s truly capable of.Second, the lengths of Wilson Fisk’s crookedness will reach new heights. It's been a while since we've seen him, and there's no way he's slowed down. Plus, he doesn’t have anyone within New York’s government to oppose him, and his inner circle is just as bad.Among the people on Fisk's team is the odious Daniel Blake, who I think will make an impact in the season 2 premiere of Daredevil: Born Again. He seems like Fisk’s protégé and he certainly takes that role seriously. But just how far is he willing to go to prove his loyalty to the Kingpin? We're about to find out. Thanks for reading.
